newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-ALANIA BEAT ROTOR TO THROW RUSSIAN TITLE RACE WIDE OPEN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ALANIA BEAT ROTOR TO THROW RUSSIAN TITLE RACE WIDE OPEN.

text.p: Champions Alania Vladikavkaz staked their claim to a second successive Russian title by beating league leaders Rotor Volgograd 3-2 at home on Wednesday to draw level on points with four games to play.
Both teams finished the match with 10 men while the victory left Rotor leading the table only on goal difference from Alania.
Rotor's top scorer Oleg Veretennikov squandered a golden chance to give his side an early lead when his tame third-minute penalty gave the Alania keeper no trouble.
Vladikavkaz, with a big partisan Caucasus crowd behind them, then took the lead through Dzhoyev in 15 minutes.

Aleksandr Shmarko equalised for Rotor on the half hour but was sent off for a second bookable offence four minutes later. Ten-man Rotor conceded goals either side of half-time from Igor Yanovsky and a penalty from Nazim Suleimanov.

Alania went down to 10 men themselves 15 minutes from time when Aslan Datdeyev was sent off for a second heavy tackle. But it was too late and Rotor could only manage a last-minute consolation strike from Vladimir Nidergaus.

That left them ahead of Vladikavkaz on goal difference only. Moscow's big battalions -- Spartak, Dynamo and CSKA -- all won on Wednesday putting them one, two and three points behind the leaders respectively and setting up a thrilling finish.
